categorisation: The gazette content announces the extension of an application deadline for a professional registration examination (for homoeopathic practitioners) administered by a statutory council. It details application procedures, fees, required documents, and exam rules. This is an administrative matter related to professional certification and regulation within the health sector, which does not fit the definitions for government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or the specific non-governmental specialized categories (Types 4-9). Therefore, it falls under the Miscellaneous category.
